integrity_notes: The result is an analytic finite-moment reconstruction backed by an elementary proof. Computer checks are finite corroboration, not a substitute for proof or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact line-invariant sampling and disjoint equal-radius holes in a known convex window; only the unlabeled pair-distance multiset is determined; full center locations, noise stability and priority certification are not established.
title: Finite-jet Crofton tomography of the distance spectrum of circular perforations
